headline: Column class dependencies and implications
what_breaks: rich/box.py — relies on box constants for table edges
rich/style.py — uses Style and StyleType for styling
rich/padding.py — requires Padding and PaddingDimensions for cell padding
why: The Column class is central to the table structure, and its attributes directly influence how tables are rendered. Changes to its dependencies could break the rendering of tables across the entire application.
checklist: Review changes to rich/box.py for edge constants
Check rich/style.py for any style-related modifications
Examine rich/padding.py for padding behavior adjustments
